name: Stygian-Sabkha
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by tectonic rift valleys. Farther poleward, past a nearby asteroid belt, the silence feels older than the soil.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Forests of black-leaved flora drink the dim light and exhale a scent like cold iron.
Nothing about the exotic matter deposit appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever controls titanium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
